football_evidence.question: Can Minnesota get UCLA off the field on third down?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward UCLA, and its own breakdown accounts for about 0.0 of the 4.2 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.
supporting: When Minnesota has the ball (the run game against the run defense): Minnesota’s offense averages 3.3 yards per carry, and UCLA’s defense allows 3.5 yards per carry (FBS average 5.0).
When Minnesota has the ball (third down): Minnesota’s offense converts 26.9% of its third downs, and UCLA’s defense allows opponents to convert 22.3% of their third downs (FBS average 39.6%).

When Minnesota has the ball (big plays on the ground): Minnesota’s offense turns 3.5% of its runs into explosive gains, and UCLA’s defense gives up explosive gains on 2.7% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.5%).

When Minnesota has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Minnesota’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 25.0% of its runs, and UCLA’s defense stops 21.8% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.5%).
contradicting: When Minnesota has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Minnesota’s offense has allowed a sack on 4.8% of its dropbacks, and UCLA’s defense sacks the quarterback on 5.3% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).
In his last two games (Michigan State and Nevada), Dieffenbach averaged 6.2 yards per attempt, against 7.9 in his two games before that.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Minnesota’s defensive line No. 20 nationally and UCLA’s No. 48.
quarterbacks: Drake Lindsey has completed 161 of 258 passes (62.4%) for 1,610 yards, 6.2 yards per attempt, 11 touchdowns and 6 interceptions in eight games for Minnesota, and has been sacked on 9 of 267 dropbacks.
Nico Iamaleava has completed 71 of 116 passes (61.2%) for 978 yards, 8.4 yards per attempt, 4 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in five games for UCLA, and has been sacked on 7 of 123 dropbacks.
Ty Dieffenbach has completed 59 of 100 passes (59.0%) for 683 yards, 6.8 yards per attempt, 3 touchdowns and 1 interception in four games for UCLA, and has been sacked on 3 of 103 dropbacks.
